content.short: ODOS.xyz leverages a unique algorithm to traverse a large universe of possible token swap combinations.
content.description: ODOS.xyz delivers optimal order routing across more than 500 liquidity sources, drawing on a broad, interconnected liquidity network to support robust trading activity. Its multi-token swap feature lets users swap between multiple assets within a single atomic transaction, simplifying complex trades and preserving execution integrity. The ODOS Price Service API provides precise token prices for thousands of assets across DeFi, enabling consistent pricing references and improved decision-making. The ODOS Smart Order Routing API ensures efficient and cost-effective transactions in DeFi.
